relationships.subject: HMGB1
relationships.evidence_quote: This molecule activates TLR4 receptors, leading to the upregulation of pro-inflammatory cytokines that may contribute to neuropathic pain

relationships.subject: BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: BDNF can enhance the NMDA receptor-mediated C-fiber induction response after binding to its high-affinity TrkB receptor.

relationships.subject: nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: Injury triggers a postsynaptic decrease in the expression of KCC2, a potassium chloride transporter, accompanied by a subsequent significant increase in sensory excitability of the dorsal horn of the spinal cord.

key_findings: Review of synaptic plasticity, neurotransmitters and inflammatory mediators in the acute-to-chronic pain transition.
